title: Assisted Living Advance Payment Amount
content:
**Definition.** Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, the advance payment is the residency account balance plus, for each coming month it covers, the contracted monthly rent, the care fee the month carries and the recurring monthly care add-ons at the amounts billed for the most recent billed month. The advance payment covers no coming month, and it is rounded once to the cent half up at the end.

**Terms used.**

- *Most recent billed month:* the billing month of the most recent full-month rent charge on the residency, ending on its last day; the coming months are the calendar months that follow it.
- *Care fee the month carries:* the monthly care fee of the care level the residency carries.
- *Recurring monthly care add-ons:* the insulin management, oxygen management, diabetic monitoring and escort assistance add-ons, at the amounts billed for the most recent billed month.
- *Assembly:* the coming months' rent, care fee and add-ons are added up month by month, the total is added to the account balance, and the advance is rounded once at the end.

### Worked figures (hypothetical residency)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Residency account balance | 1250.40 |
| Coming months covered | None |
| Advance payment | 1250.40 |
